'''Beejinz''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] merchant who lived on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
A [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Beejinz was one of many [[Pilgrims]] who settled illegally on the planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]]. He ran a business in the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]].<ref name="TOR" />
